stories.title: Tajani, dopo Eni anche Ip limita i prezzi, contributi senza imposizioni dall'alto

en.title: Tajani, after Eni also Ip limits prices, contributions without top-down impositions
en.summary: Italian officials report that energy company Ip has joined Eni in voluntarily limiting prices. A government representative stated he had previously encouraged this approach with company leadership.

stories.title: Il Papa a Lourdes: "Gli abusi sono una piaga. Nessuna legge può dare la morte"

en.title: The Pope in Lourdes: "Abuse is a scourge. No law can give death"
en.summary: The Pope celebrated Mass at a Marian sanctuary in Lourdes before approximately 150,000 attendees and addressed the issue of abuse. He is scheduled to meet with abuse victims before traveling to Metz.

stories.title: Pistoia, rifiuta approccio sessuale: torturata e quasi annegata, arrestato 38enne

en.title: Pistoia, rejects sexual advance: tortured and nearly drowned, 38-year-old arrested
en.summary: A woman was severely assaulted after refusing sexual advances, enduring beatings, stone strikes, and cigarette burns. A bystander's alarm call was instrumental in her rescue and the suspect's arrest.

stories.title: Pistoia: rifiuta approccio sessuale, torturata e quasi annegata nel fiume. Arrestato uomo di 38 anni

en.title: Pistoia: rejects sexual advance, tortured and nearly drowned in river. 38-year-old man arrested
en.summary: A woman was assaulted after firmly rejecting sexual advances from a man. The situation escalated leading to her torture and near-drowning before the suspect's arrest.

stories.title: Coppa America a Napoli: trionfa Luna Rossa, New Zeland deve arrendersi

en.title: America's Cup in Naples: Luna Rossa triumphs, New Zealand must surrender
en.summary: Luna Rossa won the America's Cup competition held in Naples, defeating New Zealand.

stories.title: Irlanda del nord, la marcia della discordia: gli orangisti unionisti sfilano tra i repubblicani

en.title: Northern Ireland, the march of discord: unionist orangists march among republicans
en.summary: A contentious march by unionist orangists took place in a predominantly republican area, with tensions reported within Sinn Féin regarding the First Minister's handling of counter-protest measures.

stories.title: Anche Ip fissa un tetto ai prezzi del carburante. L'annuncio dopo la mossa di Eni

en.title: Ip also sets a fuel price cap. The announcement after Eni's move
en.summary: Fuel company Ip announced a price cap on fuel following a similar initiative by competitor Eni, in response to government pressure.

stories.title: Pistoia, rifiuta le avances e viene torturata e quasi annegata in un fiume: arrestato un 38enne

en.title: Pistoia, woman rejects advances and is tortured and nearly drowned in a river: 38-year-old arrested
en.summary: A 38-year-old man was arrested after allegedly torturing a young woman who rejected his advances, including beating, striking with stones, and burning her face with cigarettes, before a bystander raised the alarm.

stories.title: Il Papa a Lourdes tra i malati. E oggi riceve le vittime degli abusi dei preti: “Piaga dolorosa”

en.title: The Pope in Lourdes among the sick. And today he receives victims of priest abuse: "Painful scourge"
en.summary: Pope Francis visited Lourdes and met with French bishops and seven abuse survivors. He emphasized the need for vigilance and addressed issues including end-of-life care.

stories.title: Tensione alla marcia protestante in Irlanda del Nord, folla di cattolici contro la parata Orange

en.title: Tension at protest march in Northern Ireland, crowd of Catholics against Orange parade
en.summary: Tensions remained high in Portadown, Northern Ireland, where large crowds of protesters gathered to oppose an Orange Order march.

stories.title: Irlanda del Nord, tensione altissima: catene umane di cattolici contro una marcia protestante

en.title: Northern Ireland, very high tension: human chains of Catholics against a Protestant march
en.summary: An Orange parade on a republican road was approved after 28 years of bans and overnight legal battles, with Catholics blocking the route and potential for clashes.

stories.title: Bimbo di 5 anni investito a Torino, l’ombra della vendetta: al volante l’ex fidanzata del papà

en.title: 5-year-old boy hit by car in Turin, shadow of revenge: ex-girlfriend of father at the wheel
en.summary: A 24-year-old woman was arrested for attempted murder after hitting a young child with a car in Turin while he was with his family.

stories.title: Benzina e diesel, anche Ip fisserà limiti ai prezzi

en.title: Petrol and diesel, Ip will also set price limits
en.summary: Socar is following Eni's example by implementing price caps on petrol and diesel across its Ip distribution network.

en.title: Work-life balance, certification underway
en.summary: A new certification process for companies implementing work-life balance policies under the Uni/Pdr 192:2026 standard is being launched.

stories.title: Halloween, è iniziato il conto alla rovescia per la notte dei fantasmi

en.title: Halloween, the countdown has begun for the night of ghosts
en.summary: Halloween-themed attractions featuring zombies, ghosts, skeletons, vampires, witches, monsters and pumpkins are populating theme parks during October as the All Saints' Day tradition gains prominence.

stories.title: «Regate in mezzo al publico come mai, Luna Rossa e New Zealand i team favoriti»

en.title: Races in the middle of the public like never before, Luna Rossa and New Zealand the favorite teams
en.summary: Francesco de Angelis describes the atmosphere in Naples and sailing conditions for preliminary races, with Luna Rossa and New Zealand positioned as competition favorites.

stories.title: Consolato americano a Milano, la società americana risarcisce i lavoratori con 30 milioni

en.title: American Consulate in Milan, American company compensates workers with 30 million
en.summary: Following a labor exploitation investigation by prosecutors, Caddell has reached a settlement agreement with a court-appointed administrator regarding worker compensation.
